gloss: late spring cold snap (during cherry blossom season)

definitions.gloss: late spring cold snap; cold spell during cherry blossom season
definitions.explanation: a temporary return of cold weather that occurs in late March to early April when cherry blossoms are blooming

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{花冷|はなび}え⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧。
examples.english: It's cold today due to the late spring cold snap.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{花冷|はなび}え⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: We went cherry blossom viewing but came home early due to the cold snap.

examples.japanese: {花冷|はなび}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上着|うわぎ}→上着：01066_uwagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧いった⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should bring a jacket during the late spring cold spell.

notes:
SEASONAL TERM:
This is a seasonal word (⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧) associated with spring in Japanese poetry and culture.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (flower - refers to cherry blossoms)
- {冷|び}え (cold, chill)

SEASON:
Typically occurs in late March to early April during ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧ (cherry blossom season).

RELATED SEASONAL TERMS:
- ⟦{桜前線|さくらぜんせん}→桜前線：13124_sakurazensen⟧ (cherry blossom front)
- {花曇|はなぐも}り (cloudy weather during cherry blossom season)
- ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧ (cherry blossom viewing)
